questions.clarification:
This is about how you would feel, not what you could afford. The amounts are an example only. Your answer is recorded as a range, not an exact amount. If the fall would be exactly £500, choose 'Small loss'. If exactly £2,000, choose 'Moderate loss'.
No loss: I would not be comfortable with any fall
Small loss: a fall of up to £500
Moderate loss: a fall of more than £500, up to £2,000
Significant loss: a fall of more than £2,000
Unsure

questions.clarification:
'This money' means the money you are thinking about investing. 'Essentials' means things like rent or mortgage, bills, food and travel to work.
Struggle with essentials: I would struggle to pay for essentials
Change spending: I could pay for essentials but would have to cut back on other spending
Manageable: I would not need to change my spending, but it would set back my plans
Little impact: it would make little or no difference to me
Unsure
